The situation in December 2023 suggests an improving trend.

title.narrative: Number of annual dropouts

description.narrative: Number per year.According to the Atlas Territorial de LAbandon Scolaire 20142018 (Atlas) p.16 published by the Conseil Superieur de lEducation, de la Formation et de la Recherche Scientific (CSEFRS), the average dropout rate in the primary cycle in rural areas is 4.8%. Reducing this rate by 10% to 4.32% in the schools benefitting from the interventions would be a substantial success and would be a larger reduction than the annual 0.1% that has occurred without intervention over the past few years. Naturally, the precise baseline in the schools benefitting from the intervention needs to be established by the PIQ TA consultants.

comment.narrative: The project has experienced delays linked to the slowness of the decisionmaking process on the part of the promoter to the context due to COVID creating difficulties in organising a team of ERI experts during travel restrictions as well as to some difficulties with the Promoters availability and delays in signing the cooperation agreement. These issues are typical and observed across the EIB portfolio of projects outside EU.The delays were also partly due to a temporary change of priority mainly from the Promoters side following the earthquake that hit Morocco on the 8th of September 2023. This earthquake had a major impact on the Ministry of Education destroying hundreds of schools displacing students to other parts of the country and killing many teachers. The situation in December 2023 suggests an improving trend.
